payload.objective: Poll engagement metrics for published posts, show how posts and pillars perform, and let performance decide which approved posts are sent as examples when drafting. LinkedIn metrics wait for M9 (ADR 0007).
successCriteria: FetchMetricsJob polls Facebook through ChannelAdapter::fetchMetrics on a schedule, within rate limits
LinkedIn channels show that metrics are not available yet, without errors
metric_snapshots stored per variant over time, with workspace isolation
Per-post and per-pillar performance summary in the UI
Examples sent with a draft request are ranked by performance, building on the approved-posts examples of #22
The permissions metrics need are confirmed against the current Meta documentation and recorded
Tests with metric fixtures and workspace isolation tests
